name: Magnetrons
summary: The vacuum tube that makes the microwaves in an oven: a copper anode block with cooling fins, two ferrite ring magnets and a heated cathode.
uses: Copper anode block and aluminium cooling fins
Not useful as a working tube outside an oven: leave it unpowered
identify: Finned metal block about 9 × 9 cm bolted to the waveguide, with a domed antenna on one face and two spade terminals on a filter box.
test: Filament continuity: under 1 ohm between the two terminals. Each terminal to the case should read open.

decay.note: Lasts indefinitely; the magnets keep their strength.
